file_write.scope: Only scripts/run_limma.py may create private temporary canonical inputs and model outputs plus the user-specified new JSON report inside the current working directory; it may not replace a path, escape the working directory, mutate an input, create user directories, or use the network.
file_write.reason: The bounded executor isolates R work in a private temporary directory and publishes one create-exclusive report only after complete validation.

target_enforcement.openai: Allow only private temporary work and the explicit new local JSON report inside the working directory; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.claude: Allow only private temporary work and the explicit new local JSON report inside the working directory; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.generic: Run locally and allow only private temporary work plus the caller-approved create-new JSON report.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit write approval is required for the new report path.

local_subprocess.scope: scripts/run_limma.py may execute only the resolved local Rscript with --vanilla and its immutable embedded limma worker copied into a private run directory, a fixed positional argument contract, exact R 4.4.1 and limma 3.60.6 checks, no shell, no caller code, no installation, and no fallback model.
local_subprocess.reason: limma is the sole reviewed modeling adapter; a fixed cross-process boundary keeps model execution reproducible and fail-closed.

target_enforcement.openai: Permit only the fixed local Rscript --vanilla invocation; reject shell expansion and alternate executables.
target_enforcement.claude: Permit only the fixed local Rscript --vanilla invocation; reject shell expansion and alternate executables.
target_enforcement.generic: Execute the bundled fixed adapter only after validating inputs and exact runtime versions.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit local process approval is required for the fixed R invocation.
